entries.task_id: aristocratic king|was|to address his elephant tracker
entries.description: aristocratic king was to address his elephant tracker
entries.subject: aristocratic king

spans.text: “Seyyathāpi, aggivessana, rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto nāgavanikaṁ āmanteti: “Suppose, Aggivessana, an anointed aristocratic king was to address his elephant tracker, ‘ehi tvaṁ, samma hatthidamaka, āraññakaṁ nāgaṁ damayāhi āraññakānañceva sīlānaṁ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañceva sarasaṅkappānaṁ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañceva darathakilamathapariḷāhānaṁ abhinimmadanāya gāmante abhiramāpanāya manussakantesu sīlesu samādapanāyā’ti.

entries.description: it is worthy of a king
entries.subject: it

spans.text: Rid of all crooks and flaws, and purged of defects, it is worthy of a king, fit to serve a king, and reckoned a factor of kingship.
‘Yes, Your Majesty,’ replied the elephant tracker, and did as he was asked.

‘Yes, Your Majesty,’ replied the elephant tracker, and did as he was asked.

spans.text: It is quite impossible for him to know or see or realize what can only be known, seen, and realized by renunciation.
Rid of all crooks and flaws, and purged of defects, it is worthy of a king, fit to serve a king, and reckoned a factor of kingship.
